description: This file defines classes and constants for handling ASN.1 data structures, including Buffer, OID, and Sequence classes, with functions for encoding, decoding, and parsing ASN.1 data types.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A class for managing a byte buffer with reference counting and size management.

classes.name: OID
classes.description: A class representing an Object Identifier, with methods for parsing and iterating over OID components.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: A class for handling ASN.1 sequences, including parsing tags, lengths, and values.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for Buffer, OID, and Sequence classes.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Sets or gets the size of the Buffer.

methods.name: Size()
methods.description: Returns the size of the Buffer.

methods.name: Elements()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements of an OID.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the OID or ASN.1 sequence.

methods.name: Text()
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of the OID.

methods.name: Next()
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next component.

methods.name: Value()
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 data to native types like bool, int, string, OID, or nested Sequence.
